GLOBAL GOALS

Aligned with the UN SDGs

Veda was built with three of the Sustainable Development Goals in mind.
Free homework help, revision tools and a past-paper library — no install, works offline — so cost and connectivity aren't barriers to studying well.
An AI companion for stress and study life, with a guardian-alert safety net that surfaces real crisis resources when a student is in distress.
Bring-your-own-key AI keeps Veda free to run for every student — regardless of school budget or family income.
05
UNDER THE HOOD

How It's Built

Static & hosted free
A single-page app on GitHub Pages, live at veda-net.com.
Firebase backend
Firestore powers the Forum and student data; one Cloud Function sends guardian-alert emails.
Bring-your-own-key AI
Students use their own free Gemini API key, stored locally — no shared cost, no abuse.
